# Stitchnotbitch

> Handmade crochet toys by Joanna, a grandmother in Tenerife, Canary Islands, Spain: crochet plushies (peluches de crochet / ganchillo), amigurumi and heirloom dolls, each one of a kind. Sold through her Etsy shop. Not connected with the "Stitch 'n Bitch" knitting books or groups.

## About

- Maker: Joanna, who crochets every piece by hand, one at a time, in Tenerife.
- Every toy is one of a kind: when it's sold, there isn't another.
- Materials: dolls in a soft bamboo, silk and cashmere blend; amigurumi mostly in cotton yarn; plushies in thick, velvety chenille.
- Website: https://stitchnotbitch.com/ (English) and https://stitchnotbitch.com/es/ (Spanish).

## How to buy

- All sales go through Etsy: https://www.etsy.com/shop/stitchnotbitch
- The website is a showcase only; it takes no orders or payments.

## The collection

### Handmade dolls

- [Thin Lizzie](https://stitchnotbitch.com/toys/thin-lizzie.html) (25 cm): A 25 cm handmade amigurumi doll in a soft bamboo, silk & cashmere blend.
- [Dolly Daydream](https://stitchnotbitch.com/toys/dolly.html): A sweet handmade crochet dolly with her own little outfit — soft, huggable and entirely one of a kind.

### Plushies

- [Chirpy the Chicken](https://stitchnotbitch.com/toys/chicken.html) (15 cm): Chirpy — a sweet, cuddly handmade crochet chicken with a soft texture, tiny wings and a cute pink bow.
- [Froggie the Frog](https://stitchnotbitch.com/toys/frog.html) (15 cm): Froggie — a fun and lovable handmade crochet frog with big eyes and a bright fuchsia flower.
- [Benny the Bear](https://stitchnotbitch.com/toys/bear.html) (20 cm): Benny — a sweet, cuddly handmade crochet teddy with a soft brown coat and a tiny bow.
- [Sunny the Elephant](https://stitchnotbitch.com/toys/elephant.html) (29 cm): Sunny — a sweet, cheerful handmade crochet elephant in soft velvety purple, with pink ears and a little flower.
- [Aqua the Axolotl](https://stitchnotbitch.com/toys/axolotl.html) (23 cm): Aqua — a sweet handmade crochet axolotl in velvety blue plush yarn, with a gentle smile and big shiny eyes.
